strings.en: Don't dodge at the last second!!
I'll figure out the details later!!
Time to show you my Guts!
Let's both get ready for this!!
I'm part of the Instructor Corps too!/　I can do this!
Bullseye means you hit the bull's-eye!
Move first, and you'll land the hit!
Don't take this for some mass-produced unit!
Zip in quick,/　and send 'em flying with a WHAM!
I can handle even the Alt!
Counting on you, Bilgar's big bro!
Charge in with a KABOOM, Jigan!
Don't you dare call this a leftover!
I'm counting on you, Gespenst Haken!
So-Des, I can't forgive a guy like you!
That's gotta be the commander unit!
I'll show you what Earthlings can do, Jua-Mu!
Jua-Mu! However much momentum you've got,/　I ain't losing!
I'll bring down that Commander unit!
I'll read that sword by a hair!
Here I come, Lastclans!/　I mean, Raftclans!
I'll charge in before it gets its distance!
I'm not getting sliced up by those claws!
Every last one of 'em moves the same!
I'll show you Earthling brute strength!
Handsome and rich? I'm not jealous one bit!
I'm getting to Rabulpaila no matter what!
Like I'd be scared of that scythe!
Herluga!/　The Cross Gate ain't yours!
Don't think size alone decides a fight!
That guy's way too over the top!
Snatching up Lamaris... What're you plotting?!
It's coming at us controlling Zovorg machines?!
If it's unmanned, I won't hold back!
Crystal or whatever, I'll smash it!
I'm not losing a head-on charge!
Looks like breaking it apart won't be enough!
Is that guy another Dark Brain remnant?!
XN-L! Like I'd let you wipe us out/　with that nonsense logic!
I'll smash you, mission and all, XN-L!
I've fought these guys plenty,/　but I won't let my guard down!
Like I'd lose to a Zovorg machine!
I won't let the Golaikunru have their way!
Golaikunru! Get out of Earth's sphere already!
However many times you invade Earth!
Can't leave a walking gun battery alone!
Commander unit or not, I won't lose a test of strength!
No Lion down on the job! ...Just kidding.
Best way to draw the enemy is to charge in yourself!
A Thick Cylinder! Let's do this!
I'll take down the one with the smokestack!
Horns like that make me wanna snap 'em off!
I don't plan on getting shot down here!
You guys ain't the only ones/　good at high-speed combat!
I'll exterminate these monsters in no time!
Like I'd let the Lamaris do as they please!
I'll hold back the Lamaris here!
If they combined, I'll take 'em all at once!
Even against a Lamaris Kaana, I'll do it!
I ain't getting caught by that squishy thing!
So being big and strong makes you better?!
No matter how big you get, I won't lose!
Gotta do something about the Lamaris Ida fast...!
I'll slice off those big fat arms!
It's looking more and more like the Einst...!
If we don't hurry,/　Dark Brain'll be revived...!
Can't leave a monster running loose!
Small fry, stay out of the way!
It ain't over till it's over,/　so don't count me out!
Time to rewind this.../　Er, I mean, turn this around!
Like I'd fall behind!/　...Oh wait, I already have.
A brawl like this/　is just business as usual!!
Dammit! I'm gonna survive no matter what!
Time out! Hold on, time out!!
I can't die here!/　I'm keeping my promise to her!!
Wh-What!? It cut into the frame!?
I'm used to this pattern.../　Don't underestimate my Potential!
Whoa, a Lion-heart attack!/　...This is no time for jokes!
Bilgar, I'm sticking with you/　till the very end...!!
If it comes to it... I'll ditch the armor!!
I-It punched through the Alt's armor...!!
Ugh, the mass-production model/　is actually stronger, you know!/　...What? The pilot's the problem?
It ain't over till it's over, Gu-Landon!
Damn it! Like I'd go down/　with the boss right in front of me!
Damn you, Herluga! You'll pay for that...!
B-Being bulldozed by that kind/　of performance is rough...!
Kaana-t believe this.../　Guess I'm in no shape for jokes...
The Ida's power is no laughing matter...!
Can't I beat him in a test of strength...!?
Huh? That did more damage than I thought...
Ngh!/　Even a washout has his pride, you know!
Ugh!/　Did I fall right into their trap...!?
A-At this rate, I'll never get my big moment!!
Th-The magic words at a time like this.../　Balanga Balan... whoa, whoa.
Crap! This is how it always goes!
I've come this far! I won't go down now!
Not yet!/　It'll take more than this to finish me!
Ngh! Like this'll scare the Bilgar outta me!
Dammit!/　Can't the Falken take it!?
Uh-oh!/　Lieutenant Kyosuke's gonna chew me out!
Ugh! That hit with a Hucke-BANG!
Hit or miss, it's all Hucke-luck.../　No wait, that was a hit!
Ugh! That one hit with a big thunk!
If I wreck the new model,/　who knows what Dr. Radom'll say later...!
Ngh! Like I'd lose to that guy on momentum!
Taking Al-Van's attacks over and over/　is rough...!
You'll need a little more/　to make me despair...!
Damn you, Vort! I'll turn this around!
Just you wait! I'll wipe that laugh off your face!
You can only laugh for now, got it?!
His vibe's so different, he's hard to fight...!
Damn it! It's putting out/　that much power with just bones?!
I ain't losing this big showdown!!
Were those Zovorg machines/　always this strong...?!
I'll show the Fury my guts!
I gotta read the Thorn's moves somehow...!
That monster doesn't hold back at all...!
Its attacks are heavier than before...!
You don't give up, do you, Yokijin!
Dodged it! Wait, no, it hit!?
Aww... I thought I dodged that.
A clever hawk trims its talons, y'know!/　...Huh? That's not it?
Th-that was just... the folly of youth.
A scratch like this?/　I don't have time to worry about it!
Ugh! Did I screw up again!?
Don't hold back, and don't go easy!
Don't panic...! Panic and you lose!
C-can we call that a do-over?/　No? ...Aww, man.
This is just the tip of the ice cube.../　I mean, the iceberg!
If I can't dodge it, I'll take it properly!
That's not gonna be enough/　to take down the Falken!
That's my Alt! Tough as nails!
Was that a jab to feel me out?
Underestimate me and you'll get hurt, So-Des!
Is that all you've got, Jua-Mu?!
I managed to catch that, Fu-Ruu!
Is that all you've got, Karo-Ran?!
Against Al-Van, this much is nothing!
At this rate, you'll just be an emperor with no clothes!
Show me your full power, Gomoudokka!
Don't underestimate how tough I am, Vort!
I don't wanna see any blood!
That jerk and his nuisance research!
You'll pay for that, Crystal Dragoon!
You're a lot weaker than you look!
Figures, with wings like that... It's fast!
He's light on his feet...! Because he's all bones?
That ain't enough to wipe out humanity!
If they're gonna take the bait, I'll be the bait!
Like a monster's gonna beat me!
For something that combined,/　it doesn't pack much of a punch...!
I don't wanna see that thing up close...
Ngh, that Ares is going nuts...
Gah! The Ares Geist got its teeth in me!
Even I can handle this much!
As long as they don't read my pattern!
I can see it!/　...Always wanted to say that.
Dodge enough and something's gotta miss!/　...Wait, what?
I'm not gonna be your target!
Hit or miss? Huckebein says miss!
Hit or miss, it's all Haken.../　Huh? Feel like I said that before...
Dodged it by a hair, Fu-Ruu!
Damn Al-Van, he's aiming for all the right spots...!
Ignoring energy costs? Way too extravagant!
Heh, I'll pass on your lame magic tricks!
XN-L, I'm gonna take you down for sure!
Like a Lamaris is gonna beat me!
Now that you're bigger, you've gotten slower!
Just go back to your own planet already!
I've got no time to play with monsters!
Like I'd lose to some Yokijin!
Heh! Come back next week.../　I mean, last week!
I'll shake you off just like this!
Dodged it at the last second...!
All right! That pattern's a keeper!
You picked a good spot to aim for...
If I didn't have Lato's motion data,/　that would've been close...!
Heh, don't underestimate/　Alt's explosive power!
That's Falken for ya,/　it's got some great evasion patterns!
Black's supposed to be the color of tough enemies...
Aren't its wings way too hard?
It's kinda slow. Or am I just getting better?
What's wrong, monster?! Is that it?!
That power and speed... If it hits me, I'm toast!
Better safe than sorry... and happy!
Whoa! Begone, evil spirits!/　Begone, missiles!!
I-I can't see the forest for the fleas?!/　...That's not quite right.
I'm not letting my big scene/　or the enemy get away!
You called, and here I come!
All right, it's a crisis!/　I mean, an opportunity!
We've been drilled hard on teamwork!
Lucky! An enemy right in front of me!
It's not like she's/　got me wrapped around her finger!
A long-shot gamble? I'm in too!
Now I'm part of the ATX Team!
Lieutenant Excellen,/　we're perfectly in sync on this end!
Lato, leave the rest to me!/　I'll do it right!
Lato, trust me and go on ahead!
Lato, nobody called me,/　but I'm here to help!
Lieutenant Tasuku!/　Backup straight man, cutting in!
Major Kai! I'll do this right, I promise!
I can charge in here, right, Major?
Lieutenant Lamia, I'll back you up!
Lieutenant Lamia, I'm charging in too!
Princess,/　I'll help out in Lato's place!
Princess Shine, I'll back you up!
Kota! I said I'd help, didn't I!
Fiona, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Hugo, I'll back you up!
Lieutenant Aqua, I'll take it from here!
Josh, I'll take it from here!
Rim, leave the rest to me!
Rim, I'll lend you a hand!
Touma, I'll take it from here!
Shoko, leave the rest to me!
Touya, leave the rest to me!
Akemi, I'll lend you a hand!
Check out the charging power I got from Alt!!
ATX Project combo, here we go!!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
I won't lose my big moment or my friends!
I'm pretty sure I can take a beating!
I'll stand tall! No, I'll stand guard!!
I'll protect you! No matter what!!
Seolla! I'll keep my promise to you!
Hands off Seolla!/　She'll nag me about it later!!
Lieutenant Kyosuke,/　my armor's thicker than yours! Probably!
Lieutenant Excellen,/　float like a butterfly and run for it!
Lato, lean on me at times like this!
I won't let them get Lato!
This is my moment, Lieutenant Yuuki!
Sorry, Lieutenant Tasuku!/　I'm butting in!
Major Kai! Being tough is my specialty!
Radha, hurry up and get out of here!
Princess Shine, get out of here, quick!
I'm the Royal Guard! Here goes!
Kota! I know I'm one to talk,/　but don't do anything reckless!
Lieutenant Calvina, leave this to me!
Akimi, fall back while you can!
Take this too, while you're at it!
I'm not letting this chance slip by!
The only guy in the Instructor Corps!/　Arado Balanga is here!
And this weapon's made for me!
What'll come out? Watch and see!
And to finish, a Boost Kick!!
Guess there's nothing for it but to go!
I'll show you the Bilgar's true form!
Wings deployed! Drive at full power!
Seolla, match your timing to mine!
Mode select: my kind of style!
Falken or not, I charge in and shoot!!
Shoot, shoot, and keep on shooting!!
I'll punch right through with this!!
I'll blow a hole in you with my stake!!
Now this weapon's made for me!
It's a hammer! This is gonna hurt!!
This is a real man's weapon!/　Boost Hammer!!
Shishioh Blade! I'll cut you down!!
Whether it hits is up to you!
Take this! Take this! Take thiiis!!
I'm gonna use up every last rouuund!!
Take this, take this, take thiiiis!!
Fire enough and something'll hit, dammit!!
I'll split you in two with this!
Every last one of you gets cut down!
One-on-one! How do you like that!
And to finish, the Drill Attacker!!
This is the Type-3's ultimate sword!
I can't afford to miss with this Missile!
Please, just hit! I mean it!!
By the time you notice this, it's too late!
I'm gonna throw it with all I've got!
I'll show you a Boxer's finishing move!
Blew right through at full throttle!
I'll finish you with the G-Impact Zapper!
I'll show you the Gespenst Haken's finishing move!
I'm counting on you, King of Getting Shot Down.
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Like I'd miss my big moment!
If only I could handle women this well~♪
My fists move faster than my mouth!!
A one-way trip to hell, whether you like it or not!
Dunno how many meals/　one of these shots would buy...!
I know I'm in big trouble if I miss!
I'll charge in with everything I've got!
But hey, it all worked out!
Got your back, right behind you!
I'm not out of ammo yet!
